description: Entry script for the openclaw project, managing Node.js version support, module cache, error handling, and startup procedures.

methods.name: parseNodeVersion
methods.description: Parses the Node.js version string into major and minor components.

methods.name: isSupportedNodeVersion
methods.description: Checks if the Node.js version meets the minimum required version.

methods.name: ensureSupportedNodeVersion
methods.description: Ensures the current Node.js version is supported, otherwise exits with an error message.

methods.name: isModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Determines if an error is a 'module not found' error.

methods.name: isDirectModuleNotFoundError
methods.description: Checks if a 'module not found' error matches the specific module specifier.

methods.name: installProcessWarningFilter
methods.description: Attempts to import and install process warning filters if available.

methods.name: tryImport
methods.description: Attempts to dynamically import a module and returns whether it succeeded.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if a given specifier exists as a file or directory.

methods.name: buildMissingEntryErrorMessage
methods.description: Constructs an error message indicating missing build output and instructions.

methods.name: isBareRootHelpInvocation
methods.description: Checks if the script was invoked with help flags.

methods.name: loadPrecomputedRootHelpText
methods.description: Loads precomputed root help text from a JSON file.

methods.name: tryOutputBareRootHelp
methods.description: Attempts to display the root help message if invoked with help flags.
